title: Frappe ERPNext 8.2.5 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Stock…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 8.2.5 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in a Stock module endpoint. This flaw allows authenticated users, including those with minimal privileges such as portal users or users without roles, to access on-hand stock quantities for restricted records without proper permission checks. The vulnerability enables disclosure of stock quantities and confirmation of item existence.
